subject: Upstream operational brief: wins, chokepoints, asks (week of Aug 9)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: leadership@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 07:12:00 -0700
Subject: Upstream operational brief: wins, chokepoints, asks (week of Aug 9)

Hi leadership team,

Quick weekly spot to call out the biggest operational signals heading into QBR prep. TL;DR below, full context and asks follow.

Wins:
- p99 generation latency for hosted API improved ~18% week-over-week after the new batching heuristic landed; customer-facing dashboards show corresponding drop in timeouts.
- Canary rollout for quantized-13B model finished with 95% success rate and no production fallbacks observed.
- Two major customers (one in EU, one in NA) signed small expansion pilots for dedicated slots.

Risks / chokepoints:
- APAC capacity: GPU pool utilization in apac-west is at 92% peak during 03:00–07:00 UTC; if we enter spike windows we risk degraded tail latency for multi-tenant hosted calls.
- SOC2 evidence request: Acme Cloud asked for a 6-month token-retention policy doc and sample audit logs; we can provide but need legal signoff on the retention SLA change.
- Canaries uncovered a perf regression for sequences >2048 tokens on one kernel variant — fallback mitigates it but increases cost.

Asks (actionable):
1) Approve short-term burst reserve for apac-west: +4 GPUs for 6 weeks (cost delta estimate attached). Need approval by EOD Thu so infra can provision before our expected QBR load test.
2) Legal/Compliance: quick sign-off on the proposed retention wording for Acme Cloud (I’ve cc'd laura). Deadline: Fri COB to meet their procurement window.
3) Product/Applied ML: confirm a timeline to revert the kernel variant for long sequences OR ship a targeted micro-optimization by next Tuesday; this will affect QBR performance slides.

Attachments: [Attachment: QBR_prep_slide_drafts.pdf (PDF)]
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cQBRqbr-docs, HubSpot:HS-67891

Next steps I’m taking: schedule a short apac capacity review for Wed and coordinate with infra to stage the burst pool if we get approval.

If you want this broken into the QBR slides now I can include a one-slide heatmap and 1-2 recommended mitigation lines.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

--

Thanks Jordan — solid summary. A couple quick asks from my side before we escalate the burst request: 

- Can you add p50/p95 numbers and the absolute p99 latency (ms) to the slide? Executive audience likes the delta + absolute.
- For the APAC burst, please include the cost delta as both weekly and per-request unit so finance can model it.
- On the SOC2 retention: Soojin, can your team confirm whether the proposed language changes the effective retention for other customers? If yes, we need to decouple Acme-specific addendum vs platform-wide policy.

If it's helpful, I can chair a 20-min alignment call Wed 08:30 PT to decide whether to approve the burst reserve. Jordan — please add the runbook link and any fallback timelines to the slide deck before the call.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Chief of Staff
Redwood Inference
